answer: Simultaneous spot-checks make one operator pay for every fake key at the same moment. At a random block each epoch, the lotus, a beacon nobody can predict, opens a 90-second window in which every key must solve a fresh task that takes one model about 60 seconds. The crystal, a signed per-key timestamp, proves when each reply landed. Keys that miss the window go on the ledge, a probation list that withholds rewards for 3 epochs, so a farm of 1,000 keys must rent 1,000 parallel model instances for that minute, and its rental bill grows with every fake it keeps.
